name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's motorsport journey began with a childhood fascination for Formula One, fueled by grainy broadcasts and a deep-seated curiosity for the engineering marvels behind each car. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at Tsinghua University, specializing in aerodynamics, before landing his first role at a local racing team, initially tasked with data analysis and simulation work. Over the years, Li's sharp analytical skills and proactive approach to problem-solving quickly earned him recognition, leading to a series of promotions and increasing responsibilities.

Li is a firm believer in a data-driven approach to motorsport engineering, combining rigorous analysis with creative problem-solving. He is passionate about fostering a collaborative team environment where innovation is encouraged and individual contributions are valued. His distinctive ability lies in translating complex technical concepts into practical, actionable strategies, making him a highly effective leader and a sought-after technical director.

physical.description: Li has a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Constantly fiddles with a Rubik's Cube during meetings
Keeps a meticulously organized desk with color-coded files
Has a habit of sketching technical diagrams on napkins during lunch
